name: @customergpt/mcp
stderr:
CustomerGPT MCP server (stdio) v0.1.2

Proxies the hosted CustomerGPT MCP endpoint to MCP clients that launch local servers.

Usage:
  npx -y @customergpt/mcp

Environment:
  CUSTOMERGPT_API_KEY  Workspace API key. Without it only anonymous demo tools are listed.
  CUSTOMERGPT_API_URL  Backend origin (default https://api.customergpt.ai).

Clients that support remote MCP can connect directly to https://api.customergpt.ai/api/mcp with OAuth.
